textdraw_1156225113__1983942542._value: These terms govern the use of email for the entire business relationship of the Client (including future banking relationships) with UBS Switzerland AG (hereinafter "UBS").
textdraw_1156225113__1983942542.name: txtSwissAG

textdraw_1156225113__513816412._value: These terms govern the use of email for the entire business relationship of the Client (including future banking relationships) with UBS AG (hereinafter "UBS").
textdraw_1156225113__513816412.name: txtUBSAG

textdraw_1156225113_._value: The Client authorizes UBS to use the below email addresses or domain names to send (1) electronic messages such as security recommendations, event notifications, tips, confirmations of appointment requests, publications as well as (2) general and personalized product and service information and other marketing material. These messages may reveal that the Client has certain UBS products and services and allow third parties, such as network and service providers, to conclude that a banking relationship exists. The Client has the option to request that UBS ceases to send marketing material (option "Exclusion of offers and information on UBS products and services").
textdraw_1156225113_.name: textdraw1595922783594_copy_1

textdraw_1156225113__634358081._value: If the Client wishes to use the email address(es) not only to receive the electronic messages as mentioned above from UBS, but in general for the exchange of certain information between the Client and UBS, the option "Exchange of information" needs to be selected.
textdraw_1156225113__634358081.name: textdraw1595922783594_copy_2

Exchange of information#

UBS deems any email received from the indicated email addresses or domain names to have been written by the person whose e-mail address appears as the sender's address in that email. Within its duty of care and diligence customary in the business\, UBS reserves the right to verify whether an instruction received by email originates from the Client (e.g. by phone call). Emails are processed in the ordinary course of business. In the event that the transmitted information is time critical\, the Client must choose an alternative means of communication that ensures timely processing.

]

textdraw_1156225113._value: Emails are generally sent across borders via open facilities which might be accessible to third parties. Therefore, the use of email involves certain inherent risks including, in particular (1) a lack of confidentiality and, depending on the jurisdictions involved in the transmission, a lower data protection level; (2) manipulation or falsification of the sender's address or content; (3) misuse resulting in damages caused by third parties intercepting emails; (4) system outages and other transmission errors, which can cause emails and their attachments to be delayed, mutilated, misrouted or deleted; and (5) malwares that may be spread unnoticed by third parties via email and may cause considerable damage. The Client accepts the risks of using emails, in particular the risk that the banking relationship and confidential information relating thereto might be disclosed to third parties.
textdraw_1156225113.name: textdraw1595922783594

textdraw_1156225113_._value: It is within the Client's own responsibility to be aware of and implement the security precautions customary for public electronic networks (e.g. by installing a firewall and using an anti-virus program that must be updated regularly) and to use the email address only from devices which are protected against electronic attacks and unauthorized use. In case of any doubt as to the origin of an email, the Client must contact UBS by phone. As far as permitted by law, UBS shall not be liable for losses or damages resulting from the use of email.
textdraw_1156225113_.name: textdraw1595922783594_copy_1

textdraw_1156225113_2117324873._value: UBS reserves the right to amend these terms and conditions at any time. Any amendments will be communicated to the Client and shall be deemed accepted if not rejected in writing within one month after notification. Both parties shall be entitled to revoke this Authorization by written notice at any time.
textdraw_1156225113_2117324873.name: textdraw1595922783594
